QuestInfo.name: Aura's Origin 1
QuestInfo.0: Why does the aura feel so familiar? Hurry to Momijigahara and find out.
QuestInfo.1: In Momijigahara, the aura is almost unbearably powerful. It must originate from somewhere very close by. Search for it and defeat the enemies.
QuestInfo.2: The aura's source wasn't among the Oda infantry. It's got to be close...
